name: Hamza Zafar
title: Senior React Native Developer | Full Stack Mobile Engineer
sub_title: Building Scalable Apps, One Commit at a Time 🚀
description: Senior React Native Developer & Full Stack Mobile Engineer. 6+ years building iOS and Android apps with React Native, TypeScript, and Node.js. 50+ production apps shipped focused on performance, clean architecture, and on-time delivery.

experience.title: Experience
experience.sub_title: Building Scalable Apps, One Commit at a Time 🚀
experience.description: Results-driven Full Stack Mobile Engineer with 6+ years of experience building high-performance cross-platform iOS and Android apps using React Native. Delivered 50+ production applications, improving stability by 70%+ and reducing load times by 50%+. Specialized in TypeScript, Redux/Zustand, Firebase/Supabase, and scalable backend systems (Node.js/NestJS, GraphQL). Proven track record of leading teams, maintaining 60 FPS performance, and shipping pixel-perfect, production-ready applications in fast-paced Agile environments.

experiences.title: Senior Software Engineer
description: Engineered a 3-tier TypeScript ecosystem (React Native iOS/Android, React Coach Web Dashboard, GraphQL API) backed by 70+ domain models and 150+ database migrations.
Developed dual-workflow coach programming features (workout builder, scheduling calendars, team/athlete assignment) supporting both individual and team operations.
Integrated dual payment rails (Stripe Subscriptions & Apple IAP) alongside Stripe Connect automated payout pipelines.
Built an automated video transcoding pipeline (BullMQ, FFmpeg, S3/HLS) featuring automatic retry logic alongside real-time status management for direct, team, and community chat channels.

experiences.title: Senior Mobile Engineer
description: Architected zero-downtime OTA update pipelines using Hot Updater and EAS Update, enabling same-day production hotfixes and cutting average time-to-fix from days to under 2 hours.
Led full-lifecycle mobile engineering across multi-platform client projects, integrating strictly typed REST/GraphQL APIs with Zustand state persistence.
Profiled Hermes JS engine and optimized Reanimated UI threads to sustain consistent 60 FPS on mid-tier Android devices, reducing frame drops by ~70% on critical screens.
Built offline-first caching with MMKV and TanStack Query, reducing redundant API calls by ~40% across core user flows.
Established unit and component testing standards with Jest and React Native Testing Library, increasing test coverage from near-zero to ~65% on core modules.

experiences.title: Mobile Tech Lead
description: Served as primary technical lead for an 8-engineer mobile team delivering 20+ production React Native applications across booking, retail, and service domains (combined 50k+ downloads).
Engineered a modular, typed UI component library and API client package shared across mobile apps and web admin portals, reducing feature delivery cycles by ~30%.
Refactored media-heavy screens using FlashList, memoization, and lazy loading, eliminating most frame drops and lowering time-to-interactive by ~35%.
Automated CI/CD pipelines with GitHub Actions and EAS Build while enforcing test suites (Jest, React Native Testing Library, Detox), reducing release regressions by ~45%.
Mentored junior engineers on architecture, performance, and testing practices while taking on concurrent SitePod contract work in the final months.

experiences.title: React Native Developer
description: Architected end-to-end mobile applications using Firebase as a full serverless backend (Firestore, Realtime Database, Cloud Functions, and Authentication).
Implemented real-time data sync, secure JWT session persistence with automated token refresh, and offline data persistence across core client workflows.
Configured Firebase Cloud Messaging (FCM) for targeted push campaigns, dynamic deep-linking, and automated transactional user alerts.

experiences.title: React Native Developer
description: Advanced from Mobile Engineering Intern to full-time React Native Developer, shipping 10+ cross-platform apps to the App Store and Google Play with a 4.6+ average user rating.
Authored custom native Java and Objective-C module bridges exposing hardware camera access, biometrics, and background geolocation APIs.
Engineered modular TypeScript UI primitives and handled REST API integrations for real-time application features.

degrees.title: Khwaja Fareed University of Engineering and Information Technology
degrees.subtitle: Bachelor of Science in Software Engineering
descriptions: Completed rigorous coursework covering Data Structures & Algorithms, Software Architecture, Database Systems, and Mobile Application Development.
Specialized in full-stack mobile development, integrating cross-platform frontends with scalable Node.js microservices and cloud backends.
Applied core software engineering principles to build, ship, and deploy production-ready mobile and web applications throughout my degree.

reviews.text: Always a pleasure working with Hamza. Everything he has done for me has always been perfect. Fast friendly service with perfect results, highly recommended.

Hamza built a flawless React Native mobile app 1:1 to the designs I created in Figma, with all the requested APIs I wanted. On top of building exactly what I envisioned, he thought ahead of me and added some tasteful touches to the app that only made it even better, from animations to action sheets to toasts. He was accommodating to changes, understood all requirements of the project, and even suggested a few things that definitely saved us from several headaches. I will definitely hire him again in the future, and if you're in the market to have someone work on or create a React Native mobile app, this is THE developer to hire. Code was also really clean and bug-free.

Once again, absolutely phenomenal work from Hamza. Great communication, quick turnaround, and clean code. Hamza does a great job on every React Native job I've thrown to him to help me with - this time reworking an entire app into a different niche. Will hire again!

Hamza works quickly and seamlessly with our web development team and I have no hesitation in recommending Hamza.

I recently ran into some trouble with two crucial apps we use for our business, and honestly, I was pretty stressed about it. That's when I found Hamza on Fiverr. Right from the start, Hamza was a lifesaver. During a Zoom call, he walked me through the fixes with such ease and clarity, it was clear he really knows his stuff when it comes to app troubles. What really stood out to me was how patient and understanding he was. He didn't just rush through the fixes; he made sure I understood what went wrong and how we were fixing it. He even shared some great tips on how to keep things running smoothly going forward. Thanks to Hamza, not only are our apps back in business, but I've also learned a lot more about how to manage them better. He's genuinely a great guy to work with, and I couldn't recommend him enough for anyone in a tech bind!
Third project with Hamza and same quality.

Hamza provided outstanding service, delivering exceptional results with lightning speed. His professionalism and efficiency ensured clear communication and flawless execution of my requirements.
